name: EEmo-Bench_single
description: EEmo-Bench_single is a dataset for evaluating models' ability to recognize emotions from single-turn textual inputs (single utterances). It measures classification performance across a set of discrete emotion labels and is intended to benchmark emotion-recognition systems on short, context-limited examples. The bench focuses on single-label emotion identification rather than multi-turn affective understanding.
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face benchmark used in emotion-recognition experiments; modest adoption but not a widely standardized benchmark.
